firmages.shrine.voice.age_0: A spark in the dark. I have seen you.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_1: A fire that keeps its shape. I see you.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_2: You have drawn my face in bronze. Look further.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_3: A heart that does not break. Carry it into the dark.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_4: You have heard the voices between. Now make them work.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_5: Steam and pressure: my breath, held in iron.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_6: Lightning, tamed and singing. Teach it to think.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_7: You have written the world down. Now leave it.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_8: You have walked among my stars. Come closer.
firmages.shrine.voice.age_9: Every possibility, held at once. One step remains.
firmages.blessing.hearthward.description: No monsters spawn near the shrine while it stands.
firmages.blessing.skyreading.description: Near the shrine you walk 5 % faster.
firmages.blessing.iron_will.description: Near the shrine your maximum health grows by 5 %.
firmages.blessing.attunement.description: Near the shrine experience orbs give 10 % more.
firmages.blessing.tireless_hands.descrip: Near the shrine you break blocks 5 % faster.
firmages.blessing.long_arm.description: Near the shrine you reach half a block further.
firmages.blessing.clarity.description: Near the shrine your maximum health grows by another 5 %.
firmages.blessing.starwalker.description: Near the shrine falls hurt 20 % less, and one more block of fall is safe.
firmages.blessing.resolve.description: Near the shrine your maximum health grows by another 5 %, and luck is with you.
